title: BRITZMEDI Receives FDA 510(k) Clearance for TORR RF Device
summary: BRITZMEDI's flagship TORR RF multi-wave radiofrequency device has received FDA 510(k) clearance (K212561), enabling distribution across the United States market.
content:
BRITZMEDI Co., Ltd. is proud to announce that our flagship product, the TORR RF multi-wave radiofrequency device, has received FDA 510(k) clearance under number K212561.

What This Means

This regulatory milestone allows BRITZMEDI to distribute the TORR RF across the United States, opening up one of the world's largest markets for aesthetic medical devices.

About TORR RF

The TORR RF is a next-generation multi-wave RF system that combines multiple radiofrequency modes for skin tightening, body contouring, and facial rejuvenation. Its proprietary technology delivers precise energy control for safe and effective treatments.

For more information about distributing TORR RF in your region, please contact our sales team.

title: BRITZMEDI Achieves ISO 13485:2016 Recertification
summary: BRITZMEDI has successfully completed recertification for ISO 13485:2016, reinforcing our commitment to quality management in medical device manufacturing.
content:
BRITZMEDI is pleased to announce the successful recertification of our ISO 13485:2016 quality management system.

Commitment to Quality

This recertification confirms that our design, development, and manufacturing processes continue to meet the highest international standards for medical device quality management.

ISO 13485 is the global benchmark for quality management systems in the medical device industry, and maintaining this certification is essential for our international distribution partnerships.

title: BRITZMEDI to Exhibit at Arab Health 2026 in Dubai
summary: Visit BRITZMEDI at Arab Health 2026, the largest healthcare exhibition in the Middle East, to experience our latest aesthetic medical device innovations.
content:
BRITZMEDI will be exhibiting at Arab Health 2026, held at the Dubai World Trade Centre from January 27-30, 2026.

What to Expect

Visitors to our booth can experience live demonstrations of the TORR RF, LUMINO WAVE, and our newest product offerings. Our international sales team will be available to discuss distribution opportunities.

Schedule a Meeting

To arrange a private meeting or demo during Arab Health 2026, please contact us in advance.

title: Introducing LUMINO WAVE: Next-Gen Ultrasound Technology
summary: BRITZMEDI launches LUMINO WAVE, a cutting-edge focused ultrasound device for non-invasive skin lifting and body contouring treatments.
content:
BRITZMEDI is excited to announce the launch of LUMINO WAVE, our newest focused ultrasound platform designed for non-invasive aesthetic treatments.

Key Features

  • Dual-mode focused ultrasound technology
  • Precision energy delivery for skin lifting
  • Non-invasive body contouring capabilities
  • Intuitive touchscreen interface

Availability

LUMINO WAVE is now available for distribution worldwide. Contact our sales team for pricing and distribution inquiries.

title: BRITZMEDI Expands Distribution Partnership in Japan
summary: BRITZMEDI signs an exclusive distribution agreement to bring our full product lineup to the Japanese aesthetic medical market.
content:
BRITZMEDI has signed an exclusive distribution partnership agreement to expand our presence in the Japanese aesthetic medical market.

Market Expansion

Japan represents one of the largest aesthetic device markets in Asia. This partnership will bring TORR RF, LUMINO WAVE, and ULBLANC to clinics across Japan.

The agreement includes full technical training, marketing support, and after-sales service infrastructure.

title: BRITZMEDI Featured in Korea Times: 'Rising Stars of Korean Medtech'
summary: Korea Times highlights BRITZMEDI as one of Korea's rising medical technology companies, recognizing our innovative RF and ultrasound technologies.
content:
BRITZMEDI was featured in the Korea Times as part of their 'Rising Stars of Korean Medtech' series, highlighting our contributions to the global aesthetic medical device industry.

Recognition

The article recognized BRITZMEDI's innovative approach to RF technology, our FDA clearance achievements, and our growing international distribution network spanning over 15 countries.
